name: Kiss

seoDescription: Learn what the Kiss emoji 💏 really means.

longForm.overview:
The 💏 Kiss emoji was added in Unicode 6 (2010) and is drawn as two adult figures shown kissing with a small heart floating between them. The visual cue reads instantly as couple-kissing, romantic-coded moment, or the visible 'mwah' tag. By 2026 💏 has become the go-to emoji for the couple-coded kiss reaction, the visible romantic default, and the PDA-coded reaction in close-friends and dating chats.

In modern chat 💏 does very specific work. People send it as a literal couple-kiss reference, as the visible 'mwah' tag, or as the romantic-coded default. The two figures and the small heart are the visual cue that the read is couple-coded. Writers should pick 💏 when the read is romantic couple-kiss or visible 'mwah couple' energy, and avoid it when the read is single kiss — 😘 fits better there.
longForm.howPeopleUseIt:
💏 lands on a friend's anniversary post, in a work channel where someone is signaling couple-coded energy, and in a dating-app DM where the sender is reacting with romantic-coded content. The two figures and small heart anchor the read.

In close-friends chats 💏 reads as the universal couple-kiss default and the visible 'mwah' tag. On X the emoji punctuates romantic-coded and couple-coded tweets. The emoji pairs with 😘 for the layered kiss-mark-and-couple stack and with ❤️ for the layered couple-kiss-and-heart stack.
longForm.whenNotToUse: Skip 💏 in any context where the read is single-person kiss. The two figures imply couple-coded. Avoid 💏 in contexts where the PDA-coded read could be misread as unprofessional.
longForm.howToReply:
If a friend sends 💏 on a romantic-coded message, mirror with another 💏 or ❤️ to match the energy. The couple chain reads as solidarity.

If 💏 lands as the PDA-coded default, reply with another 💏 or 🥰. And if you want to send 💏 yourself, pair it with the moment so the couple-coded read is clear.

faqs.question: What does 💏 mean in text?
faqs.answer: 💏 means couple-kissing, visible romantic-coded energy, or the visible 'mwah' tag. The two figures and the small heart are the visual cue that the read is couple-coded.

faqs.question: Is 💏 flirty?
faqs.answer: Yes. 💏 is one of the most romantic-coded emojis in the standard set. In a dating thread it reads as visible couple-coded romantic energy.

faqs.question: What does 💏 mean from a girl?
faqs.answer: From a girl or anyone, 💏 carries the same couple-coded read. There is no gendered meaning; the emoji works the same regardless.

faqs.question: What does 💏 mean at work?
faqs.answer: In Slack, 💏 rarely lands because it is too romantic-coded. Use a sentence instead; reserve 💏 for clearly couple-coded contexts.
